queries: WITH per_site AS (SELECT p.zoneref, s.entrystat, AVG(p.memusagegb) AS avg_ram_gb, AVG(p.procgpu::numeric / NULLIF(p.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM scanprocessing AS p JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref WHERE p.memusagegb >= 60.8 GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_ram_gb) AS avg_site_ram_gb, AVG(avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) AS avg_site_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM per_site GROUP BY entrystat

WITH per_site AS (SELECT p.zoneref, s.entrystat, AVG(p.memusagegb) AS avg_ram_gb, AVG(1.0 * p.procgpu / NULLIF(p.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM scanprocessing AS p JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref WHERE p.memusagegb >= 60.8 GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_ram_gb) AS avg_site_ram_gb, AVG(avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) AS avg_site_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM per_site GROUP BY entrystat;

WITH per_site AS (SELECT p.zoneref, s.entrystat, AVG(p.memusagegb) AS avg_ram_gb, AVG(CAST(p.procgpu AS numeric) / NULLIF(p.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM scanprocessing AS p JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref WHERE p.memusagegb >= 60.8 GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_ram_gb) AS avg_site_ram_gb, AVG(avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) AS avg_site_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM per_site GROUP BY entrystat;

assumptions.assumption: A GPU-to-CPU ratio is undefined when CPU usage is zero, so those ratios are excluded from the average.
